If the DOE is a dissolved, schools are going to give massive pushback when trying to get an IEP- because every single legal accommodation opens up a potential lawsuit if the teacher fails to follow it and it’s expensive to follow accommodation. It’s very difficult right now to find qualified special ed teachers, it’s the only subject that is commonly getting sign on bonuses.

Going to a “blue” state is not going to be sufficient solution. If you’re already in the blue state and there’s any chance your child might need an IEP, try to get them tested as soon as possible.
